name: 马耳他欧盟蓝卡
summary: 面向获得马耳他高技能工作，并满足高等资格或合资格经验及适用工资条件的第三国公民。
summaryEn: For third-country nationals with highly skilled employment in Malta who meet higher qualification or eligible experience and applicable salary rules.

jobOffer.summary: 须有符合该路径要求的工作邀请、合同或雇主申请。
jobOffer.summaryEn: A job offer, contract or employer filing that meets the route rules is required.

qualification.summary: 须满足职位适用的技能、资格、经验或专业认可条件。
qualification.summaryEn: The position-specific skill, qualification, experience or professional-recognition rules must be met.

assessment.summary: 须通过申请时适用的工资、职位登记、劳动力市场或其他主管机关审查。
assessment.summaryEn: Any salary, vacancy-registration, labour-market or other authority assessment in force when applying must be met.

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
